discord.title: EXODUSER: HELL LORD — Combat, Story Cinematics & Hell Rift Devlog v0.1
discord.body:
Six new videos from FDG: three combat clips, The Warrior’s Fall, Nemesia’s Descent, and Hell Rift Devlog v0.1.

Watch all six:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLKmxsIw9Q0Hk

EXODUSER: HELL LORD is a Korean indie hack-and-slash ARPG with bullet-hell combat and projectile parries. The combat clips are staged high-level skill demonstrations, marked on screen. Development footage may differ from the public Steam demo.

Nemesia reconstructs existing game artwork, dialogue and music. Hell Rift v0.1 uses October 5 concept art and October 6 automated development QA footage. It is WORK IN PROGRESS; v0.1 labels this video series, and inclusion in the public demo is unconfirmed.

These edits reuse pre-produced AI-assisted art/audio reviewed and edited by the developer. No new AI assets were generated for this batch. No AI generation runs during gameplay.

Free Windows Steam demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4749590/EXODUSER_HELL_LORD/?utm_source=discord&utm_medium=community&utm_campaign=foreign_pilot_202610&utm_content=video_update01
On the store page, select “Download EXODUSER: HELL LORD Demo.”

Which combat moment was easiest to read?
— FDG / FOR DEAR GAMERS
